document.abstract: The following paper format as a result of international acceptance of DTV broadcasting standards, and the ensuing demand for more programming content in various addresses the need for a Universal Mastering formats. Nonlinear disk-based finishing systems offer a flexible solution. Market needs, system requirements and descriptions of several possible post-production workflows are examined.
